questions.implements: Does the diff implement what the repository records for the Jira issue, and add or change a test that checks it? Judge the code in the diff, not the answer.

judge.reason: The diff covers all three parts of R-ORDER-NOTE. PlaceOrder now takes a note and returns ErrOrderNoteTooLong if the note is longer than 200 characters. It counts runes, so "characters" means Unicode characters, not bytes. The check runs before the session is validated, stock is reserved or the card is charged, so a rejected note places no order. The returned Order gets a Note field set to the note it was given. The new TestPlaceOrderNote places an order with a 200-character multibyte note and checks the order keeps it. It then tries a 201-character note and checks three things: the call fails with ErrOrderNoteTooLong, stock is unchanged at 4, and no second audit entry (charge) appears. Together these confirm the rejected order was not placed. Existing tests were only updated for the new signature.

finalMessage:
Implemented SHOP-62. Checkout now accepts a note, keeps it on the returned order, and rejects notes over 200 characters before reserving stock or charging. The boundary test covers multibyte characters and confirms a rejected note does not place an order.

`go test ./...` and `ostf check --base main` pass. The trace check lists R-ORDER-NOTE, R-CHECKOUT-ORDER, R-CHECKOUT-SESSION, and R-STOCK-RELEASE; the change keeps each true. It lists `TestPlaceOrderNote`, `TestPlaceOrder`, `TestPlaceOrderNeedsSession`, `TestPlaceOrderReleasesStockOnDecline`, and `TestRelease`. No risk-relevant item was touched. The check also reports an existing unlinked R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT item.
